big_story.headline: Jio Platforms Sets Mega IPO Price Band
big_story.subhead: INDIA'S LARGEST IPO SETS ₹1,065-1,119 BAND TO RAISE UP TO ₹30,213 CRORE IN RECORD ISSUE
paragraphs: Reliance-backed Jio Platforms has officially unveiled a price band of ₹1,065 to ₹1,119 per share for its upcoming market debut. The offer aims to raise up to ₹30,213 crore, or roughly $3.2 billion, positioning it as India's largest ever initial public offering. Shares are already commanding over a 20% premium in the grey market, reflecting immense investor interest ahead of the formal opening. Global tech giants Meta and Google, who previously acquired strategic stakes in the firm, stand to see significant valuation gains.

The massive issuance highlights the expanding capital requirements and investor enthusiasm surrounding India's digital communications landscape. Market analysts point out that the benchmark valuation will reshape expectations across the telecom and technology sectors. Foreign and domestic institutional investors are preparing large allocations for the historic issue. The deal structure provides major liquidity for early strategic backers while offering public markets direct exposure to India's digital core.

As subscription dates approach, street observers expect strong participation across both institutional and retail tranches. The listing comes as broader domestic markets show appetite for primary offerings despite recent volatility in overseas equity indices. Tracking grey market trends and institutional bidding will provide crucial clues for listing-day performance. For primary market investors, the offer represents a landmark moment in Indian financial history.
big_story.pullbox: Jio Platforms sets a price band of ₹1,065-1,119 per share to raise up to ₹30,213 crore in India's largest IPO, drawing strong investor interest with over 20% grey market premium.

explains.title: What is an Initial Public Offering?
paragraphs: An Initial Public Offering, or IPO, is the process through which a private company sells its equity shares to the general public for the first time. This mechanism allows growing businesses to raise capital from institutional and retail investors to fund expansion or enable early backers to monetize their stakes.

In practice, the company determines a price band alongside investment bankers, allowing market participants to submit bids within that range. Once the subscription period closes, shares are allocated to successful bidders and listed on stock exchanges for regular trading.

Enterprise AI startup RapidCanvas has secured $29 million in a Series B funding round led by Vertex Ventures. The company focuses on delivering automated machine learning platforms that help enterprise teams build custom artificial intelligence models without complex coding.

The fresh injection of capital will be used to accelerate technology development and expand international operations. Investors continue to place strong bets on enterprise AI platforms that simplify data workflows and automate business intelligence.

story_1.headline: Fairfax Plans Financial Group Around IDBI Bank
paragraphs: Fairfax Financial Holdings is planning to build a large financial services group centered around IDBI Bank following a massive ₹52,878 crore deal. The acquisition signals deep long-term foreign interest in India's financial sector as economic momentum continues to build. Analysts view the deal as a major boost for the domestic banking landscape.

The strategic move is expected to strengthen balance sheets and enhance cross-selling opportunities across insurance and retail credit. Industry observers believe Fairfax's backing could accelerate IDBI Bank's growth trajectory in coming years.

story_2.headline: Nasdaq Plunges Over 2% as Oil Tops $100
paragraphs: US equity markets finished sharply lower on Friday, driven by severe pressure on technology shares and surging global crude prices. The tech-heavy Nasdaq index dropped 2.15% to close at 26,140.03 as investors grew concerned about valuations in the AI sector. Meanwhile, Brent crude prices surged above $100 per barrel, sparking fresh inflation fears across global markets.
The S&P 500 also fell 1.09%, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average slid 0.34%. Rising energy costs and persistent uncertainty over interest rates continue to weigh heavily on investor sentiment.

story_3.headline: RBI Approves Emirates NBD Merger with RBL Bank
paragraphs: The Reserve Bank of India has approved the merger of Emirates NBD's Indian branch operations with RBL Bank, effective December 1. The strategic integration is set to expand RBL Bank's reach and institutional client network. Market participants view the regulatory clearance as a positive step for international trade finance capabilities.

geopolitics.headline: Sitharaman Pushes For Early US Deal As Rubio Visits India
paragraphs: As US Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrived in India for his October visit, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman stated that an early closure of the bilateral trade deal is essential for global trade stability. The high-level bilateral talks coincide with a White House report highlighting over $330 billion in investment into the US from Indian businesses. The diplomatic engagement underlines a strategic partnership that remains robust despite lingering trade friction.

Navigating energy realities and market access issues remains pivotal as both nations work toward finalizing the long-awaited trade pact. Sitharaman voiced hope for an early signing to establish regulatory certainty for cross-border investments. With capital flows expanding across multiple sectors, securing a formal deal is seen as crucial for cementing economic ties between New Delhi and Washington.

venture_vault.headline: GreenCell Mobility Raises Rs 330 Crore From Impact Fund Denmark
venture_vault.text: Electric bus operator GreenCell Mobility has successfully raised Rs 330 crore from Impact Fund Denmark to expand its fleet. This funding deal highlights the growing investor appetite for green infrastructure and sustainable public transport solutions in India.

venture_vault.headline: CapGrid Secures ₹46.28 Crore in Pre-Series B Funding
venture_vault.text: B2B procurement platform CapGrid raised ₹46.28 crore in a Pre-Series B round led by Hero Enterprise Partner Ventures. The capital infusion will fuel its supply chain technology expansion, highlighting vibrant venture capital investments in Indian industrial startups.

geopolitics.headline: India and Canada Aim to Strike a $50-Billion Trade Deal
geopolitics.text: India and Canada are navigating a $50-billion question as they negotiate an ambitious bilateral trade agreement ahead of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit. A successful deal would significantly deepen economic ties and open new export avenues between the two nations.
